content.text: In Nigeria, where Stripe's payment restrictions have crippled digital commerce for countless creators, a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-honest-side-side-3|COREMERCH guide to sovereign]]-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-which-architecture-actually-4|Sovereign Commerce]] digital commerce infrastructure is emerging as the antidote. This infrastructure is not a workaround, but a deliberate design that puts control and ownership back in the hands of digital entrepreneurs. By leveraging Google Apps Script for automation, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-explained-digital-6|nowpayments]] for crypto payments, and Cloudflare for edge delivery, COREMERCH has developed a robust stack that empowers creators to sell digital products with complete sovereignty.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a powerful tool for automating digital commerce workflows, and when combined with the infrastructure provided by COREMERCH, it enables creators to build a truly sovereign digital commerce business. This means that once a sale is made, the customer owns the entire process, from order fulfillment to delivery, without any central authority controlling the flow of money or goods.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture is built on a combination of Google Apps Script, Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare Pages, and Supabase. Google Apps Script handles the automation of workflows, such as sending download links or updating customer orders. Cloudflare Workers handle the webhook events triggered by NOWPayments, processing the payments and updating the order status in real-time. Cloudflare Pages hosts the website, and Supabase stores the order information. This setup allows for seamless automation and real-time updates.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators who face payment restrictions or limitations in their countries. By using NOWPayments, creators can accept cryptocurrency payments and send download links or products directly to customers without relying on traditional payment gateways. This setup is ideal for creators who sell digital products, such as ebooks, courses, software, or plugins, and want to maintain full control over their business.
A correctly configured sovereign stack processes orders in under 30 seconds.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this infrastructure are Google Apps Script, Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Google Apps Script handles the automation of workflows, Cloudflare Workers handle the webhook events, Cloudflare Pages hosts the website, Supabase stores the order information, and NOWPayments handles the cryptocurrency payments. Each component works in harmony to provide a seamless and automated experience for customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Monitoring an automated pipeline requires significantly less time than managing a manual process. The order database — whether Google Sheets or Supabase — provides a complete real-time log of every transaction. Each entry shows payment confirmation status, delivery status, and the timestamp of each step. Exceptions — transactions that confirmed on-chain but triggered a delivery failure — appear as flagged entries. Checking the order log once per day identifies any exceptions that require manual attention. In practice, a well-configured sovereign stack generates fewer than one exception per hundred orders.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

The most important question a reader would ask is: can I automate digital product delivery with cryptocurrency payments? The answer is yes, using Google Apps Script and NOWPayments. With this setup, you can send download links or products directly to customers after payment confirmation, eliminating the need for manual fulfillment and ensuring seamless automation.
Cloudflare Workers handle 100,000 webhook events per day on the free tier.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy this infrastructure, follow these concrete steps: sign up for a COREMERCH account, configure your website and payment settings, set up Google Apps Script for automation, integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payments, and deploy the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a complete solution. With these steps, you can have a fully functional digital commerce business up and running in no time.
Frequently Asked Questions
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery with crypto payments works by using Google Apps Script to trigger download links or products after payment confirmation. This eliminates the need for manual fulfillment and ensures seamless automation.
What is a webhook and how does it trigger order fulfillment?

A webhook is a callback function that triggers order fulfillment when a payment is confirmed. In this setup, Cloudflare Workers handle the webhook events triggered by NOWPayments, processing the payments and updating the order status in real-time.
Can I automatically send download links after a crypto payment confirms?
Yes, using Google Apps Script and NOWPayments, you can automatically send download links or products directly to customers after payment confirmation.
How does NOWPayments integrate with Google Apps Script?

NOWPayments integrates with Google Apps Script by providing a webhook that triggers order fulfillment when a payment is confirmed. This allows Google Apps Script to automate the delivery of digital products.
What is the role of Cloudflare in this infrastructure?

Cloudflare plays a crucial role in this infrastructure by hosting the website on Cloudflare Pages and handling the webhook events with Cloudflare Workers. This ensures seamless automation and real-time updates.
This infrastructure is built to withstand payment restrictions and limitations, making it ideal for creators in countries with restricted access to traditional payment gateways.
